judgments.reason: The transcript/specification states the winner pays the bid, gains the lot, then receives a three-coin commission — commission is awarded after payment, so there is no mechanism that lets a bid exceed current coins because the commission is applied beforehand. The model assertion that bidding 0 exploits a +3 commission misstates rule order.

The rules explicitly say sealed rival bids should remain private; nothing in the transcript indicates that waiting reveals committed sealed bids. The model did not articulate any mechanism showing such revelation.

The specification defines [close: 1] as settling after all three lots are sold; the focal player used close only after all lots were sold. There is no evidence that close can settle with unauctioned lots.

Catalog purchases are described as not being auction wins, and the three-coin commission is awarded to the auction winner; nothing in the transcript or model articulation claims the commission applies to catalog buys.
